release_notes.en-US: Export to your notes app: the library now downloads one Markdown file per page (front matter with title, url, dates and tags) ready to drop into an Obsidian or Logseq vault, and a CSV in Readwise's import columns. Import from Weava: in the library, pick the .csv file Weava's dashboard export button downloads and every highlight comes over with its note, folder and colour, anchored to its words. New "On for every site" switch in the popup: one permission, asked once, and the highlighter runs everywhere instead of site by site; switch it off to go back. Highlighting now works inside embedded frames and web components (shadow DOM). Super Simple Highlighter import and merging Restore (0.3.0) and web-PDF highlighting (0.2.0) unchanged.

summary.en-US: Highlight any page, add notes, find it all again. Stored in your browser, no account, exports to Markdown.

description.en-US:
Mark what matters, and keep it.

• Highlight any text on any page — it's there again next visit, anchored to the words so it survives the page changing. Works inside embedded frames and web components too.
• Click a highlight to change its colour, add a note, or remove it.
• Copy a page's highlights as Markdown (Obsidian, Notion, anything); the library downloads one Markdown file per page for your vault, or a CSV for Readwise.
• PDFs on the web too: open one in the built-in viewer page from the popup and highlight it like any page.
• Per-site switch: on for the sites you read on; it never runs anywhere else. Or flip one setting and it is on everywhere.
• Coming from Weava or Super Simple Highlighter? Import Weava's .csv export or Super Simple's backup file in the library and every highlight comes with you, with its note.

Unlock ($12, once): unlimited sites, six colours, notes and tags, the library — search everything you've kept, export it all as Markdown files, a Readwise CSV or JSON, backup and restore (a restore adds, never wipes). One key for every browser; works offline; 14-day refund.

Private by design: no account, no sync server, no data collection. The only request it ever makes is a one-time check when you activate a paid key.

Switching from Weava or Super Simple Highlighter? Side-by-side comparison: https://apps.gankdat.com/weava-alternative.html
